command: node scripts/validate_contracts.mjs --dataset data data/league data/league-validated data/realism-sample
scope: metadata, events, states, existing tracking, decision snapshots, previews and squads
decision_snapshots is a subset of data.tracking; preview counts are whole preview objects
league-validated and realism-sample are local mirrors, not additional unique matches

checks: unique identities and event IDs
5 Hz frame continuity
pitch bounds and finite coordinates
player speed and acceleration limits
velocity/coordinate agreement
ball speed and attachment
event availability and causal references
goals and scoreboard agreement
event counts and final statistics
period clocks and state snapshots
single_match.scope: Internal consistency only; not validation against real football distributions.

checks: 20 unique clubs and 10 fixtures per matchweek
every club plays exactly once per matchweek
no repeated pairing in the selected rounds
per-match metadata, summary, events, states and preview exist
all 20 clubs have a fictional 2026/27 squad and match lineups use squad players
event order, match_end and event/score consistency
substitute identity, team membership and no events from departed players
state snapshots and final statistics consistency
fixture scores, standings, totals and scorer totals agree
featured matches contain exactly 30,001 tracking frames
league.scope: Structural and internal consistency; not validation against real football data.

limitations: JSON Schema and internal consistency checks do not establish realistic football outcomes.
Legacy HTTP/model/browser interfaces are not yet wired to the new contract.
